accepted_differences: Localized source/error labels differ between old Tk, old PySide6, and current rewrite.

Old PySide6 adds explicit multi-pattern scan regressions (longest match priority, repeated hits, case-insensitive sensitive lookup, exception suppression). Current rewrite preserves those improvements; old Tk remains the visual/UX baseline and is not mechanically restored for this implementation detail.

DOCX proofreading carrier scope is body paragraphs only in old Tk, old PySide6, and current rewrite; table cells, headers, footers, footnotes, and text boxes are recorded as broader enhancement/final-artifact scope rather than a current parity regression.

Markdown proofreading sanitizer semantics match the old md_spell/text_slicer baseline: YAML frontmatter and fenced/inline code are blanked while preserving line offsets, Markdown link URLs/markers are blanked, and visible link/image alt text remains proofreadable.

The real dictionary-backed official DOCX probe includes old/current DOCX, Markdown JSON, and Markdown anchor-report artifacts under the hash-pinned external evidence directory; output DOCX hashes are not equality oracles because package timestamps vary.

Old Tk's file-backed dictionary consumer double-unwraps the already-unwrapped typos table and produces zero issues. Current deliberately matches the corrected old PySide6 behavior rather than preserving this silent user-dictionary failure.
Current DOCX/Markdown carrier tests verify that file-backed rules reach comments and JSON reports through the new plugin architecture.
